Team —

Following the final loop with Vivek earlier this week, I've put together a proposed offer package for Sarah Wong (external recruiter: ExecSearch). Key items below and attached: offer_letter_draft_SarahWong_v1.pdf, comp_band_guidelines_2026.pdf, equity_allocation_calculation.xlsx.

Proposed package (L5, SF market):
- Base: $200,000
- Target bonus: 12% (OTBI)
- Equity: 0.12% (4 year, 1 year cliff) — modeled in attached sheet
- Start date: 2026-04-06
- Relocation: none; remote SF-based

Notes: Marcus, this sits at the high end of the L5 band but within range for strong ICs. Vivek requested a slightly higher base floor to be more competitive — I modeled the comp by shifting equity down modestly to keep offer within budget cadence.

Ask: can we get a quick sign-off on base/bonus/equity so I can send the formal offer to Sarah and ExecSearch today? If any objections, please reply with concrete alternatives (e.g., bump base by $10k and drop equity by X).

Thanks —
Monica

Subject: Re: Offer proposal for Sarah Wong — SR SWE (L5)

Thanks Monica — I reviewed the draft and comp band spreadsheet. Quick notes: 

- Band check: L5 SF band (updated 2026) has base range 170k-205k, target bonus range 10-15%, and typical equity between 0.06%–0.14% depending on seniority.
- The proposed $200k base is acceptable; it is at the top quartile but not outside policy.
- Equity at 0.12% is within band; however it's slightly above what we typically give for ICs with <8 years experience. If Vivek confirms seniority, it's fine.
- If we need to free up budget for base bump, I recommend reducing equity by no more than 0.02% (to 0.10%) to maintain perceived competitiveness.

I updated comp_band_guidelines_2026.pdf with inline comments and added a redline to the equity sheet. No blockers from compensation side — approve conditionally on Vivek confirming the role level and on ExecSearch fee expectations (if any).

- Marcus
Head of Total Rewards (acting)
